text:
morgan: FYI - provisioning alert: new VPC allocation policy rolled in eu-west-1 is causing ENI attach failures on Dedicated GPU nodes. Seeing spike in 'init_attach: AccessDenied' and KMS proxy egress denies. Rolling investigation.

kai: are these the nodes in fairshare pool or reserved? logs?

morgan: fairshare pool. Example logs:
`````
[2025-11-22T13:02:11Z] node-gg-32 AttachENI Error: AccessDenied to ec2:AttachNetworkInterface for eni-0abc
[2025-11-22T13:02:12Z] kms-proxy: connection refused 169.254.169.254:443
`````

carla: @nora can you check VPC egress ACLs? Could be new deny rule from infra-hardening run.

nora: jumping in. ACLs look unchanged but there's a new firewall policy (fw-pol-gw-3) that blocks outbound 443 to metadata endpoint from private subnets. That explains the initial KMS token fetch fails. :grimacing:

ben: that firewall policy was for tenant isolation; we scoped it too wide. We can add an exception for nodes with tag 'redwood-dedicated=true'. Proposing temporary rule:
`````
allow outbound tcp 169.254.169.254:443 from tag:redwood-dedicated
`````

morgan: Will that allow ENI attach? The error was AccessDenied on AttachNetworkInterface which looks IAM-related, but tokens failing could cascade. Also audit logs show STS:AssumeRole denied for role/service-account:node-provisioner.

sre-bot: incident created: INC-1975 - VPC policy causing node provisioning failures. Priority: P2. @oncall assigned: kai

kai: I'm taking oncall. Reproduced on staging by applying fw-pol-gw-3 -> node cannot reach imds, then token fetch fails, then attach fails. IAM audit shows our node-provisioner role's aws:SourceIp condition uses ENI ip which wasn't set. Need a fix in role condition or fallback to instance-profile-based check.

carla: two action items: 1) short-term: add firewall exception for metadata and KMS proxy for tag 'redwood-dedicated' 2) medium: update role trust condition to allow request when source IP is empty/unknown (xref infra#462). I'll open PR.

nora: I'll apply temporary exception in eu-west-1 now and watch. Rolling back fw-pol-gw-3 to previous state for subnets with tag.

platform-admin-bot: deploy started by nora: terraform apply (plan id: tf-apply-1975).

morgan: after exception applied, node provisioning recovered for 3/3 pending nodes. Still seeing one queue item that failed earlier - will retry.

ben: cost note — if we revert to broader exceptions we may increase egress traffic to KMS proxies and cross-AZ calls; monitor token request counts and KMS costs. Recommend tagging KMS proxy traffic for billing.

kai: logging request: can we add an auditlog filter to capture STS:AssumeRole failures and include role/session name? That will help debug recurring failure classes.

carla: I'll add the filter and a short dashboard. Also opening a follow-up to tighten firewall rule scoping post-rollback.

morgan: thanks all. tagging @sec for postmortem and KMS policy review. closing once dashboard and PRs done.
